_comment: Every by-hand indexing request (GSC URL Inspection → Request indexing; Bing URL Inspection/Submission by hand). One row per URL: url, engine (gsc|bing), date (YYYY-MM-DD, or a full ISO time when known — the GSC quota is a rolling 24 h from the last request), by (founder|laptop-agent|unknown), result (requested|quota_exceeded|refused|already_indexed|unknown). Nothing else: no names, no e-mail, no customer data (tests/index-queue.test.js). Bing API submissions live in the bing_submissions table, not here. Rules: docs/plans/indexing-queue-2026-11-23.md.
